question: Simplify (957 + 932)² - 4 × 957 × 932.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Formula:

(a+b)2 - 4ab = (a-b)2

Calculation:

(957 + 932)2 - 4 × 957 × 932

= (957 - 932)2

= 252 = 625

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **GIVEN:**

( 957 + 932 )² - 4 × 957 × 932.

**FORMULA USED:**

BODMAS 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42bb4721cca13c7a34266d1bfbf6127eca9333c261e2e7b7a1cf02e43d5d169d.png] 

**CALCULATION :**

⇒ (1889)² - 4 × 957 × 932 

⇒ 3568321 - 4 × 957 × 932 

⇒ 3568321 - 3567696 = 625 

**∴ The value is 625.**
